headline: Godcrofts Held As Weathered Expanse Sees Heavy Fighting
war_summary: Since the morning edition Godcrofts has shifted to nine Warden holdings with none Colonial after forty-nine changes in the day, five in the last two hours to 11:21 about The Axehead, Fleecewatch and Isawa. Weathered Expanse remains the heaviest field with thirty-two changes in the day, four in the last two hours to 11:55 about Frostmarch, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest, standing four Warden to four Colonial with one base neutral amid 10,380 Colonial and 12,785 Warden losses. Stlican Shelf runs to the hour with thirty-one changes, two in the last two hours about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, holding six Warden to three Colonial. Linn Mercy shows sixteen changes, two to the cutoff about Rotdust and Outwich Ranch, at ten Colonial with one neutral. Mooring County adds two changes to 10:33 at The Wind Hills for eleven Warden with one neutral. Fisherman's Row and Stonecradle, busy earlier, record no change in the last two hours, with Fisherman's Row now nine Colonial and Stonecradle five Warden to four Colonial, while Farranac Coast and Callahan's Passage stay quiet on the wires despite continued casualties.
